name: Coalarva
look: a grub of black coal with big ruby eyes, little feelers and curved pincers, and a fat segmented abdomen burning red-hot with a yellow-hot ring round each segment
entry: It lives in caves deep underground where coal seams run thick, and it eats nothing but coal. A special organ in its abdomen turns the minerals it swallows into heat, which is why its tail end always glows.
how: The CobbleEffort starter: pick it at the starter screen (its own CobbleEffort page, after Cobblemon's regions).
Wild: very rare underground next to coal ore.
